pose_errors: meters and degrees, GT and map estimate separately; sampled snapshots include source stamps
time: simulation seconds and monotonic wall seconds; RTF = sim/wall
compute_ms: steady-clock wall time inside the wrapped computeVelocityCommands call; excludes CSV I/O and wrapper lock
CPU: controller process delta CPU seconds / wall seconds as percent of one core; same host only, load dependent
smoothness: GT message twist interpolated to 20Hz sim time, centered 5-point moving average, two np.gradient derivatives, both ends trimmed 0.25s; failed/stopped runs retain outcomes and stationary time
stop_counts: GT linear speed threshold 0.01 m/s; reversal deadbands vx/vy 0.01m/s, wz 0.02rad/s
stage_diagnostics: receive sim/wall timestamp for unstamped Twist; asynchronous stage samples indicate boundaries, not an atomic synchronized snapshot
wheel_inverse_kinematics: max abs [(vx-vy-k*wz),(vx+vy+k*wz),(vx+vy-k*wz),(vx-vy+k*wz)] / 0.0635, k=(0.35+0.6038)/2; joint feedback max separately
safety: existing samples.action default zero is not proof of observed collision-monitor intervention; static contact and true footprint clearance not instrumented
comparison: No combined score or new acceptance thresholds; observe required command box and wheel limits separately
